name: Azure AI & Microsoft Foundry
description: Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Foundry Agent Service, Azure AI services and major Azure platform updates.

items.title: Azure Developer CLI adds deployment previews for AI endpoints and other Azure services
items.summary: Microsoft’s October Azure Developer CLI release introduces `azd deploy --preview`, allowing developers to inspect resolved deployment operations before deploying, including for AI endpoints. The release also adds support for image-based deployments to Azure Container Apps express environments.

items.title: MAI-Image-2.6 and MAI-Image-2.6-Flash reach general availability in Microsoft Foundry
items.summary: MAI-Image-2.6 and MAI-Image-2.6-Flash are now generally available in Microsoft Foundry. The announcement highlights multi-reference editing with up to five images for MAI-Image-2.6 and lists starting prices: $5/$8/$38 per million text-input/image-input/image-output tokens for 2.6, and $1.75/$2.50/$19 for Flash.
